items.summary: 존잼임. 덱 빌딩의 맛이 있고 하드 모드 난이도도 좀 있음. 인플레 좀 있긴하던데 스토리는 왠만하면 다 쉽게 클리어 가능한듯. 한국어로 AI 번역 쓰긴하는데 이해할만함. 여캐 남캐 디자인이 다 진짜 이쁨. 뭔가 슬더스이랑 씹덕겜 좋아하면 진짜 재밌는 경험될듯.
items.author: kim rey

items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 never been that much hooked on a gatcha
items.summary: never been that much hooked on a gatcha Lovecraft ~ interesting story very cool character design and not only female gooner characters , also SP versions are Canon rogue like fun and deep gameplay very satisfying when combination of characters workout no elemental system ~ but every character belongs to a realm that has its own mechanic, up to two can be combined also it's very easy to pull characters, but u can have up to 12 dupes to unlock full potential. give it a try !
items.author: Tobias Asendorf
